listing.name: Show Fleet DP
listing.summary: For all the times you underestimated that modded bounty. Shows enemy's fleet DP and effective strength (how strong it is in autoresolve)
listing.aiSummary: Displays the enemy fleet's deployment points and effective strength during autoresolve.

description: Displays the enemy fleet's deployment points and effective strength during autoresolve. Helps players gauge the true power of modded bounties or other fleets before engaging.
